competitorWins: Flightradar24 is genuinely the deeper aviation tool: up to 365 days of flight history, full aircraft details (age, serial, squawk, vertical speed), 15+ live weather layers, ATC boundaries, aeronautical charts, oceanic tracks, CSV data export and airport departure/arrival boards with live ETAs. Its receiver network of ~45,000 feeders and professional data feeds give it coverage and aircraft-detail fidelity that no generalist globe matches — and its polished iOS/Android apps are best-in-class for planespotting.
description: Flightradar24 (Sweden, founded 2006) is the best-known live flight tracker, showing real-time aircraft positions from ADS-B, MLAT, radar and FAA data, with airport boards, aircraft photos and flight history. It is a flight-only specialist — it does not track ships, show live cameras, or provide satellite imagery. WorldEye is complementary for casual tracking: free live flights plus ships, cameras, weather, quakes and wildfires on one signup-free 3D globe.

tagline: The world's most popular live flight-tracking app, powered by a network of ~45,000 ADS-B receivers.
verdictCompetitor: Choose Flightradar24 if you are an aviation enthusiast, traveler or professional who needs deep aircraft detail, long flight history, airport boards and polished mobile apps — and accept the signup and paid tiers for the good stuff.
verdictWorldEye: Choose WorldEye if you want free, signup-free flight tracking alongside ships, cameras, weather and satellite imagery on one 3D globe — ideal for general planet intelligence rather than aviation-only detail.
whyWorldEye: The entire map is free with no signup — no login wall, no ads, no session limits.
One globe covers flights AND ships, live cameras, weather, earthquakes and wildfires instead of flights alone.
WorldEye Pro starts at $3.99/week — less than a single month of Flightradar24 Gold annualized.
Pro adds an AI analyst assistant and an OSINT toolkit (Nmap, DNS, WHOIS, SSL) that a flight tracker never provides.
